verdict.rationale: Firecrawl offers webhooks that fire on job lifecycle events (crawl/scrape/extract/monitor check start, progress, finish) with HMAC verification, letting users react automatically when those events occur [firecrawl-docs-7][firecrawl-docs-11][firecrawl-docs-12]. This is event-driven automation but limited to notifying an external endpoint about Firecrawl's own job states, not a general rule/condition engine for defining arbitrary triggers-and-actions workflows. Missing for 10: evidence of conditional rule definitions, multi-step action chains, or a dedicated automation/rules UI beyond simple webhook delivery.
